name: Tom Blair
why: A re-cut of the frame an earlier researcher found on the same page. Theirs is 750 by 765, dark, and cut off below his forearm; this is 865 by 1130 from the 3000-pixel scan, brighter, and keeps the desk and the ASG poster behind him.
caption_quote: Thomas Alan Blair - printed directly beneath this photograph, the third of three individually captioned portraits on the page

src.label: 1977 Talisman, p. 340, 'What's What about Who's Who'; the volume index gives him pp. 50, 277 and 340, and p. 50 is the student government page. The accompanying text names him a psychology and business major from Bellbrook, Ohio.
